authoring: New image and original RGBA samples created through public GIMP/Gegl APIs; public DrawableFilter.new configures gegl:gegl, followed by save/delete/reopen and GIMP-only preview export. No XCF bytes are assembled or patched.

featureFlag.reason: Experimental layer-effect opt-in requested by stock GIMP when creating this operation; explicitly enabled for this batch.

scope: Two finite graph forms in XCF22 from GIMP 3.2.6; not historical GIMP 2.99.18 producer qualification, unrestricted graphs or PhotoCraft/GIMP compositor equivalence.
replacement: Replaces the two historical-2-99-18-graph-* bootstrap/rewrite cases from 01382f19a825ac0456d58940ee0bea2cfecc0536. The seeds, wire writer and their provenance are removed from the current corpus; their disclosed history remains immutable.
reproduction: From the repository root, use an isolated GIMP3_DIRECTORY, set GIMP_ALLOW_GEGL_GRAPH_LAYER_EFFECT=1, and run graph_filters.py with the stock Python-Fu batch interpreter as documented in its header. PHOTOCRAFT_GRAPH_OUTPUT and PHOTOCRAFT_GRAPH_FACTS optionally redirect reproduction output. PHOTOCRAFT_GRAPH_MODE=verify performs a separate reopen without modifying the fixtures.
verification: Two separate fresh-profile generator runs produced all four XCF/PNG files byte-for-byte identically. Each run deletes the authored image and checks all 48 reopened original RGBA pixels, operation, graph string, opacity, visibility and GIMP-exported preview pixels.
pngMetadata: The shared historical_png_metadata helper removes ancillary metadata only, preserving PNG pixel-defining chunks and CRCs.
